name: Deteccion de patron CFA
description: Busca artefactos de demosaicing del Filtro de Color Bayer dejados por sensores de camara reales.
algorithm: Matriz de Filtro de Color (Bayer CFA) Demosaicing Trace Detection
mechanism: Detecta periodic correlación patrones from Bayer CFA demosaicing in real cameras. These traces are absent in generado por IA images.
parameters: Analysis: 2D autocorrelación of green channel, Expected patrón: 2x2 periodic
accuracy: Alta - 80-92% for images from known camera sensors
source: Popescu and Farid (2005), ACM Workshop on Multimedia and Security
useCase: Verifying authentic camera origin through CFA demosaicing artefactos

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries in Color Filter Array Interpolated Images. IEEE TSP.
Dirik, A.E. & Memon, N. (2009). Image tamper detection based on demosaicing artifacts. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Strong indicator of real camera origin
• Based on physical sensor hardware
• Difficult for AI to simulate CFA patrones
• Very low falso positivo rate on camera images
limitations:
• Only detecta presence/absence of CFA patrones
• Some cameras apply heavy demosaicing that masks patrones
• Resizing or heavy processing destroys CFA traces
• Cannot identify specific camera model
